crossRefs.note: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;
God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.
For Yahweh’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose…
For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
until Yahweh looks down, and sees from heaven.
God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.
“Am I a God at hand,” says Yahweh, “and not a God afar off?

translations.web: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
translations.bsb: The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.
translations.kjv: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
translations.asv: Jehovah looketh from heaven; He beholdeth all the sons of men;
